name: comp-283
title: Warning Alert Banner
description: Static warning alert banner with TriangleAlert icon, message text, optional action link, and dismissible close button. No interaction hooks.
use: You need to show persistent, dismissible warning alerts with secondary actions that remain visible until closed.
avoid: For system-wide stacked notifications; use a toast system that queues messages instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons marked aria-hidden. No motion or animation.
